data.body: Fix pushed as Gerrit change 2050: rewrote .github/complexity-baseline.README.md's 'Updating the baseline' section to (a) state the contributor path for a legitimate complexity reduction — land it, do not edit the baseline; --check reports the entry stale and passes (scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py:36-39, 63-66) — and (b) scope the --update-stale recipe explicitly to maintenance, matching the script docstring ('Maintenance rewrite', line 40) and AGENTS.md. No gate-script or baseline JSON changes. Note: the parallel docs-infrastructure audit session (epic 23e8) may relocate this content later; this change is content-accuracy only, no restructuring.
